dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures are visible across the dorsal and lateral surfaces. The most prominent structures exhibit irregular, crenulated outer perimeters with a diffuse gradient transition from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light grey-beige interior pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated within the interior of the ring structures on the upper dorsal and mid-lateral regions. Core pixel concentration decreases significantly toward the posterior region, which is dominated by low-intensity dark pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal ring structures form an obtuse scalene triangle. The spatial relationship between the two most anterior rings shows a closer proximity compared to the distance toward the third more lateral-posterior ring centroid.
